facts.fact: The New Times states the National Cyber Security Authority and the Rwanda Computer Security Incident Response Team exist and are responsible for managing and responding to cybersecurity threats, and will be supported under the World Bank Digital Acceleration Project (USD 19.5 million for cybersecurity and data protection); article dated 2025-07-09 with the briefing on 7 July.
